hero.title: Experience Authentic Italian at PizzaExpress Koramangala
hero.subtitle: Savor hand-tossed gourmet pizzas, mouth-melting cheesecake, and fresh Italian coffee, crafted with passion since 1965.

about.title: About PizzaExpress Koramangala
about.paragraph1: Welcome to PizzaExpress Koramangala, your ultimate destination for exquisite Italian flavors. We are a beloved pizzeria and cafe, proudly serving authentic hand-tossed gourmet Pizzas that promise a burst of flavor in every bite. Our menu extends to mouth-melting in-house baked cheesecake and freshly brewed Italian coffee, perfecting your dining experience.
about.paragraph2: Our legacy at PizzaExpress began in 1965, and we've been serving in style ever since. At our Koramangala location, we continue this tradition of culinary excellence, blending time-honored recipes with a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere. Join us to create memorable moments over truly great food and exceptional coffee.
